rationale: wu_2015-claude-agentic: wu_n_bands=24, wu_n_outer=1, wu_motion_range=2, wu_motion_window=2, wu_soft_thresh=0.0, val_n=200, val_chunk=4, seed=42, rationale=ITER-18 (one knob vs iter-17 best). NUMBERS motion_range(n_bands24,n_outer1,thresh0): 8->hr0.03753(RMSE0.005019), 4->hr0.09137(RMSE0.004738, SSIM back to 0.940) -- LARGE jump, wide search was injecting spurious far L1-match noise into the densified residual; narrowing cleaned it. motion_range is the most productive lever found. FAILURE MODE: on dense 128-view breast data adjacent-view detector shifts are tiny; any excess search span only adds noise. ONE KNOB: wu_motion_range 4 -> 2 (narrower still; all else locked). HYPOTHESIS: if the true midpoint shift is even smaller, range=2 restricts matches further and lowers RMSE -> hr above 0.0914; if range=2 clips genuine small shifts (hr down), the optimum brackets in (2,4) and I bisect to 3. Budget: cheaper than iter-17, ~seconds.
